answer_2.quote: We measure the level of respect for the FOFC by subtracting the log-probability of 1c-type examples (FOFC-respecting) minus the log-probability of 1d-type (FOFC-disrespecting) examples.

answer_3.quote: The targeted syntactic analysis evaluates whether Gemini Pro and PaLM show an influence of the FOFC ... we compute the log-probability of each sentence and compare FOFC‑respecting vs violating pairs.
